correctness.rationale: Rank-one edge deletion formula follows from Sherman--Morrison on the zero-sum Laplacian subspace, since R0(a*,b*)<1. Within-group contrast sectors are positive. The exact 3x3 block has H11>0, second leading principal determinant 2P/positive-denominator with P a positive-coefficient polynomial in s=m+n-4,z=(m-2)(n-2), and full determinant -4AB/positive-denominator. Sign(A B) is negative for balanced m=n>=3 and positive for all unequal integer sizes, proving inertia by Sylvester plus determinant sign. The exceptional graph K_2,2-e is P4, collinear. Strict 1-negative type follows directly from L^+; finite-dimensional perturbation yields the stated exponent trichotomy. A standalone checker independently reconstructed 25 rational networks and checked exact minor/determinant identities.

value.rationale: Deleting a single edge from an electrical biclique is a natural robustness test for Euclidean resistance embeddings. The sharp m=n if-and-only-if law shows that the one-vertex imbalance tolerance of the undeleted complete-bipartite metric disappears, even with only one edge missing. The exact one-negative-eigenvalue obstruction and full-dimensional balanced realization classify a structural infinite family, beyond a single numerical table; no broad downstream theorem is required.
